label: Late-episode D1 after a rewarded a1, about to choose a1 again
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only late in the episode: nothing before trial 60, and the firing rate rises from trial 70 to 99. The model value output is also low there (value < 7.1); value seems to track the reward still to come in the episode. Within that window it is strongly selective for the a1 side: the previous choice was a1 (79% of mass; almost nothing after a2), the reward input is 1 (86% of mass), and the agent is about to pick a1 again (96% of mass). It is a late-episode signal for staying with a1 after reward. Activation builds up over a run of rewarded a1 trials: in top windows it climbs 0.85 to 0.95 to 1.0 across consecutive rewarded a1 trials. It never fires at GO or D2, and seldom after a2 choices or unrewarded trials. The predicate uses action, the agent upcoming choice at D1. That is the agent own computation, not a future random outcome, so uses_future=false. Simpler variants: D1 & ep_trial>=70 alone gets F1 0.37 (mass recall 1.0); adding prev_action!=2 gets 0.55; adding prev_reward==1 without the upcoming choice gets 0.63. Remaining false positives are mostly early in a rewarded a1 streak, where the activation has not built up yet.
